description: I'm building ARES Archive around a simple idea: make exploring Mars feel hands-on, not distant. I'm interested in space science, coding, maps, and turning planetary data into experiences people can explore. I'd love to work with curious, reliable people interested in web development, UI/UX, astronomy, planetary science, GIS, data visualisation, or research. You don't need to know everything; bring ideas, initiative, and a willingness to learn together.
